# Jam-a-Lot

> Jam-a-Lot is a browser-based jazz practice application. It plays synthesized acoustic drums, double bass, and electric piano accompaniment over jazz standard chord charts while displaying interactive lead sheets.

## Documentation & AI Access
- [User Manual](https://app.jam-a-lot.org/manual.html): Complete user manual detailing playback controls, performance planning, chord charts, instrument mixer, custom rhythm styles, soloist AI, and microphone listening band.
- [Raw Markdown Manual](https://app.jam-a-lot.org/llms-full.txt): Complete unformatted Markdown text of the user manual for raw LLM ingestion.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Generated Rhythm Section**: Seeded pure-function generators for walking basslines, phrase-aware comping piano, and dynamic drums across 13+ jazz and Latin feels (Swing, Ballad, Gypsy Jazz, Bossa Nova, Salsa, Bolero, Soul-Jazz, Funk, EDM, Waltz). Bolero piano develops an eight-bar statement from bordoneo, tresillo, partial-cell answers, space, and high-energy cinquillo rather than repeating a one- or two-bar loop.
- **Live Changes**: Runtime-only reharmonization with strict blues/Rhythm Changes fingerprints plus destination-aware tritone, secondary-dominant, passing-diminished, backdoor, full tritone ii-V, and reviewed turnaround substitutions. Same-bar and cross-bar cadences are supported, and Flow plans a stable phrase-wide density without overlapping a written arrival. Coltrane defaults on with fixed two-, three-, and four-bar ii-V-I layouts; strict blues and Rhythm Changes can also borrow atomic Bird Blues and complete bridge families. Every device preserves bar count, timing, and its written arrival; same-root extensions are color rather than substitutions.
- **The Listening Band**: Real-time microphone listening engine using Web Audio FFT bin subtraction to follow soloist energy, density, and register without speaker feedback bleed.
- **Instrument Mixer**: dB-calibrated mixer with pan positioning, custom SFZ sample import, per-kit fader memory, and synthetic drum voice design.
- **Chord Chart Editors & User Tunes**: Visual grid editor and live text-mode editor supporting universal lead-sheet shorthand (`|:`, `:|`, numbered first/second endings, `N.C.`, `x4`, section labels). In a Form header, `A` plays both endings while `A[2]` goes directly to ending 2; expanded and Vintage charts show complete passes as `A[1]` / `A[2]`, and Repeat View stays folded with the active ending highlighted during playback. Half bars / Double bars re-spread the same chords over half or twice the bars. Chord input accepts lowercase and hand-written shorthand, unreadable symbols are reported rather than dropped, and unsaved editor text is recoverable. Modifying catalog standards automatically forks a personal user tune.
- **Tune Sharing & Cloud Sync**: Send charts directly to `@handle`, share via links (`#share=code`) or QR code, manage an incoming Shared Tunes Inbox with preview/accept, and auto-sync user libraries across devices.
- **IP Safety Enforcement**: User-original compositions retain custom lyrics and melody notes; catalog standards strip all lyrics and melody before generating share payloads.
